svg.title: The Same $25,000, Licensed Versus Unlicensed
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-licensing-exposure-waterfall; chapter number: 3; chart type: waterfall; title: The Same $25,000, Licensed Versus Unlicensed; subtitle: California licensing cost against securities rescission exposure; caption: Meeting California's commercial finance license costs a fee of $500 to $1,000 against a $25,000 net-worth floor, while selling another sponsor's security without a license can turn a $25,000 fee into a $1 million judgment.; assumptions note: Two separate scenarios sit side by side. Bars one to three use Funder Intel's California figures at the high end of the fee range; bars four to six use Trowbridge Law Group's rescission example. Result bars are plain arithmetic.; note: Sources are Funder Intel and Trowbridge Law Group.; bars: label: California net-worth floor; value: 25000; display: $25,000; kind: total; label: License fee at the high end; value: -1000; display: -$1,000 (range $500 to $1,000); kind: deduction; label: Net worth after the license fee; value: 24000; display: $24,000; kind: result; label: Fee for selling a $1M raise unlicensed; value: 25000; display: $25,000; kind: total; label: Rescission judgment; value: -1000000; display: -$1,000,000; kind: deduction; label: Net exposure after rescission; value: -975000; display: -$975,000; kind: result
